name: Shared Source-Aware Dispatch Workspace

implemented_behavior: Implemented shared source-aware Dispatch Workspace supporting Service Requests, Rental Reservations, Sales Orders, and Direct Manual Operational Drafts
Added explicit source identity badges (Service, Rental, Sale, Manual) with manual_intake provenance tag for manually entered dispatches
Clarified manual intake provenance as a direct operational draft without requiring upstream Core 1 commercial transactions

Added source-specific requirements and completion panels for Service (project, service type, site notes, checklist), Rental (reservation window, condition requirements, operator context), Sale (delivery destination coordinates, catalog items, fulfillment mode), and Manual (provenance, technical checklist)
Added Reconciliation Queue section to surface unlinked Core 1 commercial handoffs and detect matching existing operational drafts to prevent duplicate dispatches
Preserved shared scheduling (Day/Week/Month), resource assignment, approval gates, MapLibre tracking, and mobile progression across all four sources
